description: A compact architecture fixture for version-sensitive practical knowledge demonstrated through functioning builds and debugging.

mastery.instructions: Submit a working version-scoped circuit plus a concise trace of one deliberately introduced failure: observed state, first incorrect component, hypothesis, test, and repair.

edges.rationale: Timing control depends on predicting ordinary power and component behavior.
Practical logic circuits depend on stable signal timing as well as logical state.
Debugging requires a correct behavioral model of the circuit being traced.
The wiki documents component and edition-specific behavior.
Construction and state labeling connect logical descriptions to game behavior.
Deliberate perturbation produces a bounded debugging experience.
The artifact demonstrates both a functioning repair and the reasoning that produced it.
